pages.title: The Canal Lock | BitPoints Series 1 | Infrastructure Academy

pages.title: The Steam Engine | BitPoints Series 1 | Infrastructure Academy

pages.title: The Railway Bridge | BitPoints Series 1 | Infrastructure Academy

pages.title: The Internet | BitPoints Series 1 | Infrastructure Academy

pages.title: Form & Function | BitPoints Series 1 | Infrastructure Academy

pages.title: Iron Age | BitPoints Series 1 | Infrastructure Academy
pages.description: Iron built empires. Stronger tools meant stronger walls, longer roads, and larger armies.

pages.title: Classical Era | BitPoints Series 1 | Infrastructure Academy
pages.description: Greece proved that infrastructure is not just physical. Democracy, philosophy, and geometry are the foundations of civilisation.

pages.description: Navigation infrastructure — ships, charts, ports — connected every continent and created the modern world.

pages.description: Electricity made the invisible visible. Electricity made the invisible visible. The power grid became the nervous system of modern civilisation.

pages.title: Space Age | BitPoints Series 1 | Infrastructure Academy
pages.description: Infrastructure left the atmosphere. The Space Age proved that engineering has no ceiling.

pages.description: The Digital Age turned information into infrastructure. Data flows faster than water, and code builds faster than concrete.
